corrections.text: The article attributes the quote "a +49.0 absolute improvement over the base ReAct model" to "the paper's abstract." The quote is accurate and verbatim, but it actually appears in Section 3.2 (Main Results) of the paper, not the abstract. The paper's abstract states only that EvoHarness-RL "reaches 96.9% success" without citing the +49.0-point figure.
